contea di ritrovamento: Worcestershire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [ ] DIVI F D[ ]NVS COS VII ; R/ [ ] INCEPS IVVENTVTIS

An incomplete struck / hammered silver denarius of Domitian (AD 81 - AD 96), during Titus's reign (AD 79 - 81), minted in AD 80. Obverse description: Head facing right. Obverse inscription: [ ] DIVI F D[ ]NVS COS VII. Reverse description: Altar, garlanded and lighted. Reverse inscription: [ ] INCEPS IVVENTVTIS. Reece period: 4. Coin reference: RIC II, p.122, #49. Diameter: 17.43mm. Thickness: 2.55mm. Weight: 2.5 grams
